Two Bills Passed in Lok Sabha Amid Chants, Tribunal Reforms Bill Cleared

Two significant bills were passed in the Lok Sabha amidst chanting, without debate. The Tribunal Reforms Bill was also passed in the Rajya Sabha. In total, nine bills have been passed in the Lok Sabha without debate, with discussions only held on two of them. The entire process for the two bills passed on this occasion took approximately 14 minutes.
